If it succeeds, you can't use this feature on it again. If it fails, it becomes friendly to you and obeys your commands until you use this feature again.

Intelligent undead are harder to control in this way. If the target has an Intelligence of 8 or higher, it has advantage on the saving throw. If it fails the saving throw and has an Intelligence of 12 or higher, it can repeat the saving throw at the end of every hour until it succeeds and breaks free.

subclassFeatures.name: School of Transmutation
entries: You are a student of spells that modify energy and matter. To you, the world is not a fixed thing, but eminently mutable, and you delight in being an agent of change. You wield the raw stuff of creation and learn to alter both physical forms and mental qualities. Your magic gives you the tools to become a smith on reality's forge.

Some transmuters are tinkerers and pranksters, turning people into toads and transforming copper into silver for fun and occasional profit. Others pursue their magical studies with deadly seriousness, seeking the power of the gods to make and destroy worlds.

subclassFeatures.name: Minor Alchemy
entries: Starting at 2e level when you select this school, you can temporarily alter the physical properties of one nonmagical object, changing it from one substance into another. You perform a special alchemical procedure on one object composed entirely of wood, stone (but not a gemstone), iron, copper, or silver, transforming it into a different one of those materials. For each 10 minutes you spend performing the procedure, you can transform up to 1 cubic foot of material. After 1 hour, or until you lose your {@status concentration} (as if you were {@status concentration||concentrating} on a spell), the material reverts to its original substance.

subclassFeatures.name: Transmutation Savant
entries: Beginning when you select this school at 2e level, the gold and time you must spend to copy a transmutation spell into your spellbook is halved.

subclassFeatures.name: Transmuter's Stone
entries: Starting at 6e level, you can spend 8 hours creating a transmuter's stone that stores transmutation magic. You can benefit from the stone yourself or give it to another creature. A creature gains a benefit of your choice as long as the stone is in the creature's possession. When you create the stone, choose the benefit from the following options:

items: Vision dans le noir out to a range of 60 feet, as described in chapter 8.
An increase to speed of 10 feet while the creature is unencumbered.
Proficiency in Constitution saving throws.
Resistance to acid, cold, fire, lightning, or thunder damage (your choice whenever you choose this benefit).

entries: Each time you cast a transmutation spell of 1er level or higher, you can change the effect of your stone if the stone is on your person.
If you create a new transmuter's stone, the previous one ceases to function.

subclassFeatures.name: Shapechanger
entries: At 10e level, you add the {@spell polymorph} spell to your spellbook, if it is not there already. Vous pouvez lancer {@spell polymorph} sans dépenser d'emplacement de sort. When you do so, you can target only yourself and transform into a {@filter beast whose challenge rating is 1 or lower|bestiary|challenge rating=[&0;&1]|type=beast|miscellaneous=!swarm}.
Once you cast {@spell polymorph} in this way, you can't do so again until you finish a short or long rest, though you can still cast it normally using an available spell slot.

subclassFeatures.name: Master Transmuter
entries: Starting at 14e level, you can use your action to consume the reserve of transmutation magic stored within your transmuter's stone in a single burst. When you do so, choose one of the following effects. Your transmuter's stone is destroyed and can't be remade until you finish a long rest.

entries.name: Major Transformation
entries: You can transmute one nonmagical object—no larger than a 5-foot cube—into another nonmagical object of similar size and mass and of equal or lesser value. You must spend 10 minutes handling the object to transform it.

entries.name: Panacea
entries: You remove all curses, diseases, and poisons affecting a creature that you touch with the transmuter's stone. The creature also regains all its hit points.

entries.name: Restore Vie
entries: You cast the {@spell raise dead} spell on a creature you touch with the transmuter's stone, sans dépenser d'emplacement de sort or needing to have the spell in your spellbook.

entries.name: Restore Youth
entries: You touch the transmuter's stone to a willing creature, and that creature's apparent age is reduced by {@dice 3d10} years, to a minimum of 13 years. This effect doesn't extend the creature's lifespan.

subclassFeatures.name: Magie de guerre
entries: A variety of arcane colleges specialize in training wizards for war. The tradition of Magie de guerre blends principles of evocation and abjuration, rather than specializing in either of those schools. It teaches techniques that empower a caster's spells, while also providing methods for wizards to bolster their own defenses.

Followers of this tradition are known as war mages. They see their magic as both a weapon and armor, a resource superior to any piece of steel. Guerre mages act fast in battle, using their spells to seize tactical control of a situation. Their spells strike hard, while their defensive skills foil their opponents' attempts to counterattack. Guerre mages are also adept at turning other spellcasters' magical energy against them.

In great battles, a war mage often works with evokers, abjurers, and other types of wizards. Évocateurs, in particular, sometimes tease war mages for splitting their attention between offense and defense. A war mage's typical response: "What good is being able to throw a mighty {@spell fireball} if I die before I can cast it?"

subclassFeatures.name: Arcane Deflection
entries: At 2e level, you have learned to weave your magic to fortify yourself against harm. When you are hit by an attack or you fail a saving throw, you can use your reaction to gain a +2 bonus to your AC against that attack or a +4 bonus to that saving throw.
When you use this feature, you can't cast spells other than cantrips until the end of your next turn.

subclassFeatures.name: Tactical Wit
entries: Starting at 2e level, your keen ability to assess tactical situations allows you to act quickly in battle. You can give yourself a bonus to your initiative rolls égale à votre Intelligence modifier.

subclassFeatures.name: Power Surge
entries: Starting at 6e level, you can store magical energy within yourself to later empower your damaging spells. In its stored form, this energy is called a power surge.

You can store a maximum number of power surges égale à votre Intelligence modifier (minimum of one). Whenever you finish a long rest, your number of power surges resets to one. Whenever you successfully end a spell with {@spell dispel magic} ou {@spell counterspell}, you gain one power surge, as you steal magic from the spell you foiled. If you end a short rest with no power surges, you gain one power surge.

Once per turn when you deal damage to a creature or object with a wizard spell, you can spend one power surge to deal extra force damage to that target. The extra damage equals half your wizard level.

subclassFeatures.name: Durable Magic
entries: Beginning at 10e level, the magic you channel helps ward off harm. While you maintain {@status concentration} on a spell, you have a +2 bonus to AC and all saving throws.

subclassFeatures.name: Deflecting Shroud
entries: At 14e level, your Arcane Deflection becomes infused with deadly magic. When you use your Arcane Deflection feature, you can cause magical energy to arc from you. Up to three creatures of your choice that you can see within 60 feet of you each take force damage equal to half your wizard level.

subclassFeatures.name: Chronurgy Magic
entries: Focusing on the manipulation of time, those who follow the Chronurgy tradition learn to alter the pace of reality to their liking. Using the ramping of anticipatory dunamis energy, these mages can bend the flow of time as adroitly as a skilled musician plays an instrument, lending themselves and their allies an advantage in the blink of an eye.
{@note Note: This subclass has access to {@book Dunamancy Spells|EGW|5|Dunamancy Spells}}.

subclassFeatures.name: Chronal Shift
entries: {@i 2e-level Chronurgy Magic feature}

You can magically exert limited control over the flow of time around a creature. As a reaction, after you or a creature you can see within 30 feet of you makes an attack roll, an ability check, or a saving throw, you can force the creature to reroll. You make this decision after you see whether the roll succeeds or fails. The target must use the result of the second roll.
You can use this ability twice, and you regain any expended uses when you finish a long rest.

subclassFeatures.name: Temporal Awareness
entries: {@i 2e-level Chronurgy Magic feature}
You can add your Intelligence modifier to your initiative rolls.

subclassFeatures.name: Momentary Stasis
entries: {@i 6e-level Chronurgy Magic feature}

Par unen action, you can magically force a Large or smaller creature you can see within 60 feet of you to make a Constitution saving throw against your spell save DC. Unless the saving throw is a success, the creature is encased in a field of magical energy until the end of your next turn or until the creature takes any damage. While encased in this way, the creature is {@condition incapacitated} and has a speed of 0.
You can use this feature a number of times égale à votre Intelligence modifier (a minimum of once). You regain all expended uses when you finish a long rest.

subclassFeatures.name: Arcane Abeyance
entries: {@i 10e-level Chronurgy Magic feature}

When you cast a spell using a spell slot of 4e level or lower, you can condense the spell's magic into a mote. The spell is frozen in time at the moment of casting and held within a gray bead for 1 hour. This bead is a Tiny object with AC 15 and 1 hit point, and it is immune to poison and psychic damage. When the duration ends, or if the bead is destroyed, it vanishes in a flash of light, and the spell is lost.

A creature holding the bead can use its action to release the spell within, whereupon the bead disappears. The spell uses your spell attack bonus and save DC, and the spell treats the creature who released it as the caster for all other purposes.
Once you create a bead with this feature, you can't do so again until you finish a short or long rest.

subclassFeatures.name: Convergent Future
entries: {@i 14e-level Chronurgy Magic feature}

You can peer through possible futures and magically pull one of them into events around you, ensuring a particular outcome. When you or a creature you can see within 60 feet of you makes an attack roll, an ability check, or a saving throw, you can use your reaction to ignore the die roll and decide whether the number rolled is the minimum needed to succeed or one less than that number (your choice).
When you use this feature, you gain one level of {@condition exhaustion}. Only by finishing a long rest can you remove a level of {@condition exhaustion} gained in this way.

subclassFeatures.name: Graviturgy Magic
entries: Understanding and mastering the forces that draw bodies of matter together or drive them apart, the students of the Graviturgy arcane tradition learn to further bend and manipulate the violent energy of gravity to their benefit, and the terrible detriment of their enemies.
{@note Note: This subclass has access to {@book Dunamancy Spells|EGW|5|Dunamancy Spells}}.

subclassFeatures.name: Adjust Density
entries: {@i 2e-level Graviturgy Magic feature}

Par unen action, you can magically alter the weight of one object or creature you can see within 30 feet of you. The object or creature must be Large or smaller. The target's weight is halved or doubled for up to 1 minute or until your {@status concentration} ends (as if you were {@status concentration||concentrating} on a spell).

While the weight of a creature is halved by this effect, the creature's speed increases by 10 feet, it can jump twice as far as normal, and it has disadvantage on Strength checks and Strength saving throws. While the weight of a creature is doubled by this effect, the creature's speed is reduced by 10 feet, and it has advantage on Strength checks and Strength saving throws.
Upon reaching 10e level in this class, you can target an object or a creature that is Huge or smaller.

subclassFeatures.name: Gravity Well
entries: {@i 6e-level Graviturgy Magic feature}

You've learned how to manipulate gravity around a living being: whenever you cast a spell on a creature, you can move the target 5 feet to an unoccupied space of your choice if the target is willing to move, the spell hits it with an attack, or it fails a saving throw against the spell.

subclassFeatures.name: Violent Attraction
entries: {@i 10e-level Graviturgy Magic feature}

When another creature that you can see within 60 feet of you hits with a weapon attack, you can use your reaction to increase the attack's velocity, causing the attack's target to take an extra {@damage 1d10} damage of the weapon's type.
Alternatively, if a creature within 60 feet of you takes damage from a fall, you can use your reaction to increase the fall's damage by {@damage 2d10}.
You can use this feature a number of times égale à votre Intelligence modifier (a minimum of once). You regain all expended uses when you finish a long rest.

subclassFeatures.name: Event Horizon
entries: {@i 14e-level Graviturgy Magic feature}

Par unen action, you can magically emit a powerful field of gravitational energy that tugs at other creatures for up to 1 minute or until your {@status concentration} ends (as if you were {@status concentration||concentrating} on a spell). For the duration, whenever a creature hostile to you starts its turn within 30 feet of you, it must make a Strength saving throw against your spell save DC. On a failed save, it takes {@damage 2d10} force damage, and its speed is reduced to 0 until the start of its next turn. On a successful save, it takes half as much damage, and every foot it moves this turn costs 2 extra feet of movement.
Une fois cette aptitude utilisée, vous devez terminer un long rest or until you expend a spell slot of 3e level or higher on it.

subclassFeatures.name: Bladesinging
entries: Bladesingers master a tradition of wizardry that incorporates swordplay and dance. Originally created by elves, this tradition has been adopted by non-elf practitioners, who honor and expand on the elven ways.

In combat, a bladesinger uses a series of intricate, elegant maneuvers that fend off harm and allow the bladesinger to channel magic into devastating attacks and a cunning defense. Many who have observed a bladesinger at work remember the display as one of the more beautiful experiences in their life, a glorious dance accompanied by a singing blade.

subclassFeatures.name: Bladesinger Styles
entries: From its inception as a martial and magical art, Bladesinging has been tied to the sword, more specifically the longsword. Yet many generations of study gave rise to various styles of Bladesinging based on the melee weapon employed. The techniques of these styles are passed from master to students in small schools, some of which have a building dedicated to instruction. Even the newest styles are hundreds of years old, but are still taught by their original creators due to the long lives of elves. Most schools of Bladesinging are in Evermeet or Evereska. One was started in Myth Drannor, but the city's destruction has scattered those students who survived.

Styles of Bladesinging are broadly categorized based on the type of weapon employed, and each is associated with a category of animal. Within that style are specializations named after specific animal types, based on the types of spells employed, the techniques of the master, and the particular weapon used. Bladesingers who apprentice to a master typically get a tattoo of their chosen style's animal. Some bladesingers learn multiple styles and bear many tattoos, wearing a warning on their skin of their deadly skills.

entries.name: Cat
entries: Styles that employ a sword belong to this family. The lion style, the eldest, trains practitioners in the use of the longsword and doesn't favor any particular type of spells. Leopard style focuses on the shortsword and spells of illusion and stealth. Red tiger, a style just three centuries old, has its bladesingers using the scimitar in a whirling dance of defense from which they launch into sudden leaps and attacks.

entries.name: Bird
entries: Styles that focus on the use of a hafted weapon, such as an axe or hammer, have been grouped together as bird styles, yet they vary wildly. All relatively new styles, they use weapons not typically favored by elves. Eagle-style bladesingers use small handaxes, and many maneuvers in the style focus on fluid ways to throw the weapon and draw a new one. Raven style uses a war pick, and spells associated with it grant the bladesinger more agility in combat.

entries.name: Snake
entries: Practitioners of these styles use a flail, chain, or whip. Viper style uses a whip, despite its inelegance as a weapon, and has almost as long a history as the lion style. Its masters punctuate their bladesong with a stunningly rapid rhythm of whip cracks, which can keep many foes at bay and allow the bladesinger space to cast the cruel spells of poison and disease favored by the style.

subclassFeatures.name: Bladesong
entries: Starting at 2e level, you can invoke a secret elven magic called the Bladesong, provided you aren't wearing medium or heavy armor or using a shield. It graces you with supernatural speed, agility, and focus.

You can use a bonus action to start the Bladesong, which lasts for 1 minute. It ends early if you are {@condition incapacitated}, if you don medium or heavy armor or a shield, or if you use two hands to make an attack with a weapon. You can also dismiss Bladesong at any time you choose (no action required).
While your bladesong is active, you gain the following benefits:

items: You gain a bonus to your AC égale à votre Intelligence modifier (minimum of +1).
Your walking speed increases by 10 feet.
Vous disposez d'unedvantage on Dexterity ({@skill Acrobatics}) checks.
You gain a bonus to any Constitution saving throws you make to maintain {@status concentration} on a spell. The bonus equals your Intelligence modifier (minimum of +1).

entries: You can use this feature a number of times égale à votre proficiency bonus, and you regain all expended uses of it when you finish a long rest.

subclassFeatures.name: Training in Guerre and Song (Bladesinging)
entries: When you adopt this tradition at 2e level, you gain proficiency with light armor, and you gain proficiency with one type of one-handed melee weapon of your choice.
You also gain proficiency in the {@skill Performance} skill if you don't already have it.

subclassFeatures.name: Attaque supplémentaire
entries: Starting at 6e level, you can attack twice, instead of once, whenever you take the {@action Attack} action on your turn. Moreover, you can cast one of your cantrips in place of one of those attacks.

subclassFeatures.name: Song of Defense
entries: Beginning at 10e level, you can direct your magic to absorb damage while your bladesong is active. When you take damage, you can use your reaction to expend one spell slot and reduce that damage to you by an amount equal to five times the spell's slot level.

subclassFeatures.name: Song of Victory
entries: Starting at 14e level, you add your Intelligence modifier (minimum of +1) to the damage of your melee weapon attacks while your Bladesong is active.

subclassFeatures.name: Order of Scribes
entries: Magic of the book-that's what many folk call wizardry. The name is apt, given how much time wizards spend poring over tomes and penning theories about the nature of magic. It's rare to see wizards traveling without books and scrolls sprouting from their bags, and a wizard would go to great lengths to plumb an archive of ancient knowledge.

Among wizards, the Order of Scribes is the most bookish. It takes many forms in different worlds, but its primary mission is the same everywhere: recording magical discoveries so that wizardry can flourish. And while all wizards value spellbooks, a wizard in the Order of Scribes magically awakens their book, turning it into a trusted companion. All wizards study books, but a wizardly scribe talks to theirs!

subclassFeatures.name: Awakened Spellbook
entries: {@i 2e-level Order of Scribes feature}
Using specially prepared inks and ancient incantations passed down by your wizardly order, you have awakened an arcane sentience within your spellbook.
While you are holding the book, it grants you the following benefits:

items: You can use the book as a spellcasting focus for your wizard spells.

When you cast a wizard spell with a spell slot, you can temporarily replace its damage type with a type that appears in another spell in your spellbook, which magically alters the spell's formula for this casting only. The latter spell must be of the same level as the spell slot you expend.

When you cast a wizard spell as a ritual, you can use the spell's normal casting time, rather than adding 10 minutes to it. Once you use this benefit, you can't do so again until you finish a long rest.

entries: If necessary, you can replace the book over the course of a short rest by using your Magicienly Quill to write arcane sigils in a blank book or a magic spellbook to which you're attuned. At the end of the rest, your spellbook's consciousness is summoned into the new book, which the consciousness transforms into your spellbook, along with all its spells. If the previous book still existed somewhere, all the spells vanish from its pages.

subclassFeatures.name: Magicienly Quill
entries: {@i 2e-level Order of Scribes feature}
Par une bonus action, you can magically create a Tiny quill in your free hand. The magic quill has the following properties:

items: The quill doesn't require ink. When you write with it, it produces ink in a color of your choice on the writing surface.
The time you must spend to copy a spell into your spellbook equals 2 minutes per spell level if you use the quill for the transcription.
You can erase anything you write with the quill if you wave the feather over the text as a bonus action, provided the text is within 5 feet of you.

entries: This quill disappears if you create another one or if you die.

subclassFeatures.name: Manifest Mind
entries: {@i 6e-level Order of Scribes feature}

You can conjure forth the mind of your Awakened Spellbook. As a bonus action while the book is on your person, you can cause the mind to manifest as a Tiny spectral object, hovering in an unoccupied space of your choice within 60 feet of you. The spectral mind is intangible and doesn't occupy its space, and it sheds dim light in a 10-foot radius. It looks like a ghostly tome, a cascade of text, or a scholar from the past (your choice).
While manifested, the spectral mind can hear and see, and it has {@sense darkvision} with a range of 60 feet. The mind can telepathically share with you what it sees and hears (no action required).

Whenever you cast a wizard spell on your turn, you can cast it as if you were in the spectral mind's space, instead of your own, using its senses. You can do so a number of times per day égale à votre proficiency bonus, and you regain all expended uses when you finish a long rest.
Par une bonus action, you can cause the spectral mind to hover up to 30 feet to an unoccupied space that you or it can see. It can pass through creatures but not objects.

The spectral mind stops manifesting if it is ever more than 300 feet away from you, if someone casts {@spell dispel magic} on it, if the Awakened Spellbook is destroyed, if you die, or if you dismiss the spectral mind as a bonus action.
Once you conjure the mind, you can't do so again until you finish a long rest, unless you expend a spell slot of any level to conjure it again.

subclassFeatures.name: Master Scrivener
entries: {@i 10e-level Order of Scribes feature}

Whenever you finish a long rest, you can create one magic scroll by touching your Magicienly Quill to a blank piece of paper or parchment and causing one spell from your Awakened Spellbook to be copied onto the scroll. The spellbook must be within 5 feet of you when you make the scroll.

The chosen spell must be of 1er or 2e level and must have a casting time of 1 action. Once in the scroll, the spell's power is enhanced, counting as one level higher than normal. Vous pouvez lancer the spell from the scroll by reading it as an action. The scroll is unintelligible to anyone else, and the spell vanishes from the scroll when you cast it or when you finish your next long rest.

You are also adept at crafting spell scrolls, which are described in the treasure chapter of the Dungeon Master's Guide. The gold and time you must spend to make such a scroll are halved if you use your Magicienly Quill.

subclassFeatures.name: One with the Word
entries: {@i 14e-level Order of Scribes feature}

Your connection to your Awakened Spellbook has become so profound that your soul has become entwined with it. While the book is on your person, you have advantage on all Intelligence ({@skill Arcana}) checks, as the spellbook helps you remember magical lore.

Moreover, if you take damage while your spellbook's mind is manifested, you can prevent all of that damage to you by using your reaction to dismiss the spectral mind, using its magic to save yourself. Then roll {@dice 3d6}. The spellbook temporarily loses spells of your choice that have a combined spell level equal to that roll or higher. For example, if the roll's total is 9, spells vanish from the book that have a combined level of at least 9, which could mean one 9e-level spell, three 3e-level spells, or some other combination. If there aren't enough spells in the book to cover this cost, you drop to 0 hit points.

Until you finish {@dice 1d6} long rests, you are incapable of casting the lost spells, even if you find them on a scroll or in another spellbook. After you finish the required number of rests, the spells reappear in the spellbook.
Once you use this reaction, you can't do so again until you finish a long rest.

subclassFeatures.name: Abjurateur
entries: {@i Protégez vos compagnons et bannissez les ennemis}

Votre étude de la magie se concentre sur les sorts qui bloquent, bannissent ou protègent : qui mettent un terme aux effets néfastes, bannissent les influences maléfiques et veillent sur les faibles. On fait appel aux abjurateurs chaque fois qu'il s'agit d'exorciser un esprit malin, de protéger un lieu contre l'espionnage magique ou de refermer un portail ouvrant sur d'autres plans d'existence. Les groupes d'aventuriers apprécient d'avoir un abjurateur parmi eux pour la protection qu'il offre contre les attaques hostiles, qu'elles soient magiques ou non.

subclassFeatures.name: Abjurateur érudit
entries: Choisissez deux sorts de {@filter Magicien de l'école de l'Abjuration|spells|level=0;1;2|class=Magicien|school=A}, chacun du 2e niveau au maximum, et ajoutez-les gratuitement à votre grimoire.

En outre, chaque fois que vous recevez l'accès à un nouveau niveau d'emplacements de sort dans cette classe, vous pouvez ajouter gratuitement à votre grimoire un sort de Magicien de l'école de l'Abjuration. Le sort choisi doit être d'un niveau pour lequel vous disposez d'emplacements de sort.

subclassFeatures.name: Égide arcanique
entries: Tisser un voile magique autour de vous permet de vous protéger. Lorsque vous lancez un sort d'Abjuration avec un emplacement de sort, vous pouvez simultanément utiliser un brin de la magie du sort pour créer une égide magique sur vous-même, qui persiste jusqu'à ce que vous ayez terminé un {@variantrule Repos long|PHB24}. Cette égide dispose d'un maximum de {@variantrule Hit Points|PHB24|Hit Point} égal à deux fois votre niveau de Magicien + votre modificateur d'Intelligence. Chaque fois que vous subissez des dégâts, l'égide les subit à votre place, et si vous avez des Résistances ou Vulnérabilités, appliquez-les avant de réduire les {@variantrule Points de Vie|PHB24}. Si ces dégâts réduisent l'égide à 0 {@variantrule Points de Vie|PHB24}, vous subissez les éventuels dégâts résiduels. Quand l'égide se retrouve à 0 {@variantrule Points de Vie|PHB24}, elle ne peut plus absorber de dégâts mais sa magie demeure.

Chaque fois que vous lancez un sort d'Abjuration avec un emplacement de sort, l'égide regagne un nombre de {@variantrule Points de Vie|PHB24} égal à deux fois le niveau de l'emplacement dépensé. Par une {@variantrule Action Bonus|PHB24}, vous pouvez aussi dépenser un emplacement de sort. L'égide regagne un nombre de {@variantrule Points de Vie|PHB24} points de vie égal à deux fois le niveau de l'emplacement dépensé.
Une fois l'égide créée, vous ne pouvez plus la recréer avant d'avoir terminé un {@variantrule Repos long|PHB24}.

subclassFeatures.name: Égide projetée
entries: Lorsqu'une créature que vous voyez dans un rayon de 9 m subit des dégâts, vous pouvez jouer votre {@variantrule Réaction|PHB24} pour que votre Égide arcanique absorbe ces dégâts. Si ces dégâts réduisent l'égide à 0 {@variantrule Points de Vie|PHB24}, la créature protégée subit les éventuels dégâts résiduels. Si cette créature a des Résistances ou Vulnérabilités, appliquez-les avant de réduire les {@variantrule Points de Vie|PHB24} de l'égide.

subclassFeatures.name: Briseur de sorts
entries: Les sorts {@spell contresort|PHB24} et {@spell dissipation de la magie|PHB24} sont toujours considérés comme préparés pour vous. Vous pouvez en outre lancer {@spell dissipation de la magie|PHB24} par une {@variantrule Action Bonus|PHB24}, et ajouter votre {@variantrule Maîtrise|PHB24|Bonus de Maîtrise} au test de caractéristique associé.
Lorsque vous lancez l'un ou l'autre sort avec un emplacement de sort, cet emplacement n'est pas dépensé si le sort ne parvient pas à contrecarrer un sort.

subclassFeatures.name: Résistance aux sorts
entries: Vous avez l'{@variantrule Avantage|PHB24} aux jets de sauvegarde contre les sorts et la {@variantrule Résistance|PHB24} aux dégâts des sorts.

subclassFeatures.name: Devin
entries: {@i Apprenez les secrets du multivers}

Les conseils avisés d'un devin sont recherchés par ceux et celles qui souhaitent avoir une vue plus claire du passé, du présent et de l'avenir. En tant que devin, vous êtes expert dans l'art de déchirer le voile de l'espace, du temps et de la conscience. Vous œuvrez à maîtriser les sorts de discernement, de vision à distance, de savoir surnaturel et de prémonition.

subclassFeatures.name: Devin érudit
entries: Choisissez deux sorts {@filter Magicien de l'école de la Divination|spells|level=0;1;2|class=Magicien|school=D}, chacun du 2e niveau au maximum, et ajoutez-les gratuitement à votre grimoire.

En outre, chaque fois que vous recevez l'accès à un nouveau niveau d'emplacements de sort dans cette classe. vous pouvez ajouter gratuitement à votre grimoire un sort de {@filter Magicien de l'école de la Divination|spells|class=Magicien|school=D} Le sort choisi doit être d'un niveau pour lequel vous disposez d'emplacements de sort.

subclassFeatures.name: Présage
entries: Des lambeaux d'avenir commencent à s'imposer à votre conscience. Chaque fois que vous terminez un {@variantrule Repos long|PHB24}, lancez deux d20 et notez les résultats obtenus. Vous pouvez substituer le résultat de tout {@variantrule Test d20|PHB24} effectué par vous-même ou une créature que vous voyez par l'un de ces tests prophétiques. Vous devez choisir de faire ainsi avant le jet, et ne pouvez substituer un jet de cette manière qu'une seule fois par tour.
Chaque test prophétique ne peut être utilisé qu'une seule fois. En terminant un {@variantrule Repos long|PHB24}, vous perdez tous les tests prophétiques inutilisés.

subclassFeatures.name: Divination experte
entries: Lancer des sorts de Divination vous est si facile que cela ne vous demande plus qu'un effort minimal. Lorsque vous lancez un sort de Divination en dépensant un emplacement de sort du 2e niveau ou plus, vous récupérez un emplacement de sort dépensé. L'emplacement que vous récupérez ainsi doit être d'un niveau inférieur à celui de l'emplacement que vous venez de dépenser et ne peut pas être supérieur au 5e niveau.

subclassFeatures.name: Troisième œil
entries: Vous pouvez augmenter vos capacités de perception. Par une {@variantrule Action Bonus|PHB24}, choisissez l'un des bénéfices suivants, qui persiste jusqu'à ce que vous commenciez un {@variantrule Repos court|PHB24|Short} ou {@variantrule Repos long|PHB24}. Vous ne pouvez ensuite plus recourir à cette aptitude avant d'avoir terminé un {@variantrule Repos court|PHB24|Short} ou {@variantrule Repos long|PHB24}.

entries.name: Vision dans le noir
entries: Vous recevez la {@sense Vision dans le noir|PHB24} sur 36 m.

entries.name: Compréhension supérieure
entries: Vous savez lire toutes les langues.

entries.name: Détection de l'invisibilité
entries: Vous pouvez lancer {@spell détection de l'invisibilité|PHB24} sans dépenser d'emplacement de sort.

subclassFeatures.name: Présage renforcé
entries: Vos visions oniriques s'intensifient et esquissent dans votre esprit une image plus précise de l'avenir. Lancez trois d20 au lieu de deux dans le cadre de votre aptitude Présage.

subclassFeatures.name: Évocateur
entries: {@i Créez des effets élémentaires détonants}

Vos études magiques ont essentiellement porté sur les effets élémentaires les plus puissants : gel intense, flammes ardentes, tonnerre roulant, crépitements de la foudre et corrosions de l'acide. Certains évocateurs œuvrent au service d'armées comme artilleurs spécialisés. D'autres utilisent leur pouvoir pour protéger autrui, tandis que d'autres encore cherchent avant tout à briller.

subclassFeatures.name: Évocateur érudit
entries: Choisissez deux sorts de {@filter Magicien de l'école d'Évocation|spells|level=0;1;2|class=Magicien|school=V}, chacun du 2e niveau au maximum, et ajoutez-les gratuitement à votre grimoire.

En outre, chaque fois que vous recevez l'accès à un nouveau niveau d'emplacements de sort dans cette classe. vous pouvez ajouter gratuitement à votre grimoire un sort de {@filter Magicien de l'école d'Évocation|spells|class=Magicien|school=V} Le sort choisi doit être d'un niveau pour lequel vous disposez d'emplacements de sort.

subclassFeatures.name: Sort mineur appuyé
entries: Vos sorts mineurs restent redoutables pour les créatures qui croyaient s'y soustraire. Lorsque vous lancez un sort mineur sur une créature et que vous ratez votre jet d'attaque ou que la cible réussit son jet de sauvegarde, celle-ci subit la moitié des dégâts éventuels du sort mineur mais aucun effet supplémentaire de ce dernier.

subclassFeatures.name: Façonneur de sorts
entries: Vous pouvez créer des niches protectrices au sein des zones d'effet de vos sorts d'évocation. Lorsque vous lancez un sort d'Évocation qui affecte d'autres créatures que vous voyez, vous pouvez en désigner un nombre n'excédant pas 1 + le niveau du sort. Les créatures choisies réussissent automatiquement leur jet de sauvegarde contre le sort et ne subissent aucun dégât si elles étaient censées les réduire de moitié en cas de réussite.

subclassFeatures.name: Évocation améliorée
entries: Chaque fois que vous lancez un sort de Magicien de l'école de l'Évocation, vous pouvez ajouter votre modificateur d'Intelligence à un jet de dégâts de ce sort.

subclassFeatures.name: Surcharge magique
entries: You Vous savez désormais augmenter la puissance de vos sorts. Lorsque vous lancez un sort de Magicien avec un emplacement de sort du 1er au 5e niveau et infligeant des dégâts, vous pouvez infliger le maximum de dégâts avec ce sort au tour où vous le lancez.

La première fois que vous procédez ainsi, vous ne subissez aucun effet indésirable. Si vous recourez de nouveau à cette aptitude avant d'avoir terminé un {@variantrule Repos long|PHB24}, vous subissez {@damage 2d12} dégâts nécrotiques pour chaque niveau de l'emplacement de sort, aussitôt après l'avoir lancé. Ces dégâts ne sont pas affectés par la {@variantrule Résistance|PHB24} et {@variantrule Immunité|PHB24}.
Chaque fois que vous réutilisez cette aptitude avant de terminer un {@variantrule Repos long|PHB24}, les dégâts nécrotiques par niveau de sort augmentent de {@damage 1d12}.

subclassFeatures.name: Illusionniste
entries: {@i Tissez des sorts subtils de tromperie}
Spécialisé dans la magie qui éblouit les sens et trompe l'esprit, vous façonnez des illusions qui donnent le sentiment que l'impossible est réel.

subclassFeatures.name: Illusionniste érudit
entries: Choisissez deux sorts de {@filter Magicien de l'école d'Illusion|spells|level=0;1;2|class=Magicien|school=I}, chacun du 2e niveau au maximum, et ajoutez-les gratuitement à votre grimoire.

En outre, chaque fois que vous recevez l'accès à un nouveau niveau d'emplacements de sort dans cette classe. vous pouvez ajouter gratuitement à votre grimoire un sort de {@filter Magicien de l'école d'Illusion|spells|class=Magicien|school=I} Le sort choisi doit être d'un niveau pour lequel vous disposez d'emplacements de sort.

subclassFeatures.name: Illusions améliorées
entries: Vous pouvez lancer des sorts d'Illusion sans composante verbale, et si un sort d'Illusion que vous lancez a une portée de 3 m ou plus, sa portée augmente de 18 m..

Vous connaissez en outre le sort mineur {@spell illusion mineure|PHB24}  vous le connaissez déjà, vous apprenez un autre sort mineur de Magicien de votre choix. Ce sort mineur n'est pas décompté de votre nombre de sorts mineurs connus. Vous pouvez créer à la fois un son et une image avec une seule incantation d'{@spell illusion mineure|PHB24}, pouvez le lancer par une {@variantrule Action Bonus|PHB24}.

subclassFeatures.name: Créatures fantasmagoriques
entries: Les sorts {@spell convocation de bête|PHB24} et {@spell convocation de fée|PHB24} sont toujours considérés comme préparés pour vous. Chaque fois que vous lancez l'un ou l'autre sort, vous pouvez changer son école en Illusion, ce qui donne à la créature convoquée une apparence spectrale. Vous pouvez lancer la version Illusion de chaque sort sans dépenser d'emplacement de sort, mais le lancer sans emplacement réduit de moitié les {@variantrule Points de Vie|PHB24}. Une fois que vous avez lancé l'un ou l'autre sort sans dépenser d'emplacement, vous devez terminer un {@variantrule Repos long|PHB24} avant de pouvoir le relancer de cette manière.

subclassFeatures.name: Calque illusoire
entries: Lorsqu'une créature vous touche avec un jet d'attaque, vous pouvez jouer votre {@variantrule Réaction|PHB24} pour interposer une réplique illusoire de vous-même entre l'assaillant et vous. L'attaque vous rate automatiquement, puis l'Illusion se dissipe.

Une fois cette aptitude utilisée, vous devez terminer un {@variantrule Repos court|PHB24|Short} ou {@variantrule Repos long|PHB24} pour pouvoir y recourir de nouveau. Vous pouvez également retrouver son usage en dépensant un emplacement du 2e niveau ou supérieur (pas d'action requise)

subclassFeatures.name: Réalité chimérique
entries: Vous avez appris à entremêler la magie de l'ombre dans vos illusions pour leur conférer un semblant de réalité. Lorsque vous lancez un sort d'Illusion avec un emplacement de sort, vous pouvez choisir un objet inanimé et non magique qui fait partie de l'illusion et rendre cet objet réel. Vous pouvez faire ainsi à votre tour par une {@variantrule Action Bonus|PHB24} pendant que le sort est en cours. L'objet reste réel pendant 1 minute, durant laquelle il ne peut ni infliger de dégâts ni faire subir d'état. Vous pourriez par exemple créer l'illusion d'un pont enjambant un gouffre, puis le rendre réel et l'emprunter pour traverser.

subclassFeatures.name: Bladesinger
entries: {@i Wield Weapon and Magicienry in Elegant Tandem}

Bladesingers master a tradition of wizardry that incorporates swordplay and dance. In combat, a Bladesinger uses intricate, elegant maneuvers that fend off harm and allow the Bladesinger to channel magic into devastating attacks and a cunning defense. Many who have observed a Bladesinger at work remember the display as one of the more beautiful experiences in their life—a glorious dance accompanied by a singing blade.

Bladesinging is associated with the ancient elven societies that first mastered the art and coined the term. Even today, most Bladesingers still hail from old elven realms, such as Myth Drannor, or from non-elven societies that share land and history with elves, such as the Silver Marches. Wherever they hail from, Bladesingers take their talents all across the Realms to help common people and perform heroic deeds. Most communities greet the arrival of a Bladesinger as a good omen.

subclassFeatures.name: Bladesong
entries: Par une {@variantrule Action Bonus|PHB24}, you invoke an elven magic called the Bladesong, provided you aren't wearing armor or using a Shield.

The Bladesong lasts for 1 minute and ends early if you have the {@condition Neutralisé|PHB24} condition, if you don armor or a Shield, or if you use two hands to make an attack with a weapon. You can dismiss the Bladesong at any time (no action required).

While the Bladesong is active, you gain the following benefits. You can invoke the Bladesong a number of times égale à votre Intelligence modifier (minimum of once), and you regain all expended uses when you finish a {@variantrule Repos long|PHB24}. You regain one expended use when you use Arcane Recovery.

entries.name: Agility
entries: You gain a bonus to your AC égale à votre Intelligence modifier (minimum of +1), and your {@variantrule Vitesse|PHB24} increases by 10 feet. In addition, you have {@variantrule Avantage|PHB24} on Dexterity ({@skill Acrobaties|PHB24}) checks.

entries.name: Bladework
entries: Whenever you attack with a weapon with which you have proficiency, you can use your Intelligence modifier for the attack and damage rolls instead of using Strength or Dexterity.

entries.name: Focus
entries: When you make a Constitution saving throw to maintain {@status Concentration|PHB24}, you can add your Intelligence modifier to the total.

subclassFeatures.name: Training in Guerre and Song
entries: You gain proficiency with all Melee Martial weapons that don't have the {@itemProperty 2H|PHB24|Two-Handed} ou {@itemProperty H|PHB24|Heavy} property. You can use a Melee weapon with which you have proficiency as a {@variantrule Focaliseur d'incantation|PHB24} for your Magicien spells.
You also gain proficiency in one of the following skills of your choice: {@skill Acrobaties|PHB24}, {@skill Athlétisme|PHB24}, {@skill Représentation|PHB24}, or {@skill Persuasion|PHB24}.

subclassFeatures.name: Attaque supplémentaire
entries: You can attack twice, instead of once, whenever you take the {@action Attaque|PHB24} action on your turn. Moreover, you can cast {@filter one of your Magicien cantrips that has a casting time of an action|spells|level=0|class=wizard|cast time=action} in place of one of those attacks.

subclassFeatures.name: Song of Defense
entries: When you take damage while your Bladesong is active, you can take a {@variantrule Réaction|PHB24} to expend one spell slot and reduce the damage taken by an amount equal to five times the spell slot's level.

subclassFeatures.name: Song of Victory
entries: After you cast a spell that has a casting time of an action, you can make one attack with a weapon as a {@variantrule Action Bonus|PHB24}.

subclassFeatures.name: Conjurer
entries: {@i Step Across Space and Call Creatures from Thin Air}

A Conjurer considers distance and matter to be flexible guidelines rather than physical laws. Conjurers master magic that moves creatures instantly through space and summons creatures to fight on their behalf.

subclassFeatures.name: Benign Transposition
entries: Par une {@variantrule Action Bonus|PHB24}, you teleport up to 30 feet to an unoccupied space that you can see. Alternatively, you can choose a space within range that is occupied by a Medium or smaller creature. If that creature is willing, you both teleport, swapping places.
You can use this feature a number of times égale à votre Intelligence modifier (minimum of once), and you regain all expended uses when you finish a {@variantrule Repos long|PHB24}.

subclassFeatures.name: Conjuration Savant
entries: Choose two {@filter Magicien spells from the Conjuration school|spells|level=0;1;2|class=Magicien|school=C}, each of which must be no higher than level 2, and add them to your spellbook for free.

In addition, whenever you gain access to a new level of spell slots in this class, you can add one {@filter Magicien spell from the Conjuration school|spells|class=Magicien|school=C} to your spellbook for free. The chosen spell must be of a level for which you have spell slots.

subclassFeatures.name: Distant Transposition
entries: The range of your Benign Transposition feature increases to 60 feet. Additionally, you can restore one use of it by expending a level 3+ spell slot (no action required).

subclassFeatures.name: Durable Summons
entries: When you cast a {@filter Conjuration spell|spells|school=C} to summon or create a creature using a spell slot, that creature gains {@variantrule Points de Vie Temporaires|PHB24} equal to twice your Magicien level when it first appears. While it has these {@variantrule Points de Vie Temporaires|PHB24}, the creature has {@variantrule Résistance|PHB24} to every damage type except Force, Necrotic, Psychic, and Radiant.

subclassFeatures.name: Focused Conjuration
entries: Taking damage can't break your {@status Concentration|PHB24} on {@filter Conjuration spells|spells|school=C}.

subclassFeatures.name: Splintered Summons
entries: When you use a spell slot to cast a {@filter Conjuration spell|spells|school=C} that summons a spirit whose stat block is included in the spell description, such as {@spell convocation d'aberration|PHB24}, you can modify the spell to summon two creatures with the spell instead of one. Each creature is of the same kind, uses the stat block and rules denoted by the spell, and manifests in a different unoccupied space of your choice within the spell's range, but the summoned creatures' {@variantrule Hit Points|PHB24|Hit Point} maximums and current {@variantrule Points de Vie|PHB24} are halved. If you lose {@status Concentration|PHB24} on the spell, both creatures disappear.

Once you use this feature to modify a spell in this way, you must finish a {@variantrule Repos long|PHB24} before you can do so again. You can also restore your use of it by expending a level 5+ spell slot (no action required).

subclassFeatures.name: Enchanter
entries: {@i Entrance and Beguile Others}
An Enchanter's magic clouds or captivates minds. Some Enchanters use their abilities to encourage peace and soften cruelty, while others use their mind-altering magic for selfish ends.

subclassFeatures.name: Enchanting Conversationalist
entries: You gain proficiency in one of the following skills of your choice: {@skill Tromperie|PHB24}, {@skill Intimidation|PHB24}, or {@skill Persuasion|PHB24}.
In addition, when you make an ability check with the chosen skill, you gain a bonus to the check égale à votre Intelligence modifier (minimum of +1).

subclassFeatures.name: Enchantment Savant
entries: Choose two {@filter Magicien spells from the Enchantment school|spells|level=0;1;2|class=Magicien|school=E}, each of which must be no higher than level 2, and add them to your spellbook for free.

In addition, whenever you gain access to a new level of spell slots in this class, you can add one {@filter Magicien spell from the Enchantment school|spells|class=Magicien|school=E} to your spellbook for free. The chosen spell must be of a level for which you have spell slots.

subclassFeatures.name: Hypnotic Presence
entries: Your charming words and enchanting gaze can enthrall another creature. As a {@action Magique|PHB24} action, choose one creature that you can see within 10 feet of yourself. If the target can see or hear you, it must succeed on a Wisdom saving throw against your spell save DC or have the {@condition Charmé|PHB24} condition for 1 minute or until the target is more than 10 feet away from you, the target can neither see nor hear you, or the target takes damage. While {@condition Charmé|PHB24}, the target has the {@condition Neutralisé|PHB24} condition and a {@variantrule Vitesse|PHB24} of 0.
You can use this feature a number of times égale à votre Intelligence modifier (minimum of once), and you regain all expended uses when you finish a {@variantrule Repos long|PHB24}.

subclassFeatures.name: Split Enchantment
entries: When you use a spell slot to cast an {@filter Enchantment spell|spells|school=E}, such as {@spell charme-personne|PHB24}, that can be cast with a higher-level spell slot to target an additional creature, you can increase the spell's effective level by 1.
You can use this feature a number of times égale à votre Intelligence modifier, and you regain all expended uses when you finish a {@variantrule Repos long|PHB24}.

subclassFeatures.name: Instinctive Charm
entries: When a creature within 30 feet of you that you can see hits you with an attack roll, you can take a {@variantrule Réaction|PHB24} to force the attacker to make a Wisdom saving throw against your spell save DC. On a failed save, the attack misses instead, and if there is another creature within range of the attack other than the attacker, the attacker targets that creature with the triggering attack, using the same attack roll. If multiple creatures are within the attack's range, you choose which one to target.

Once you take this {@variantrule Réaction|PHB24}, you can't do so again until you finish a {@variantrule Repos long|PHB24}. You can also restore your use of it by casting an {@filter Enchantment spell|spells|school=E} with a spell slot.

subclassFeatures.name: Alter Memories
entries: You can make a creature unaware of your magical influence. When you cast an {@filter Enchantment spell|spells|school=E} that imposes the {@condition Charmé|PHB24} condition using a spell slot, you can choose one creature targeted by the spell. That creature remains unaware of being {@condition Charmé|PHB24} by you.

In addition, once before the spell ends, you can take a {@action Magique|PHB24} action to force the chosen creature to make an Intelligence saving throw against your spell save DC. On a failed save, you can make the creature lose a number of hours of its memories equal to 1 plus your Intelligence modifier (minimum of 1 hour lost). You can make the creature forget less time, and the amount of time can't exceed the duration of your {@filter Enchantment spell|spells|school=E}.

subclassFeatures.name: Necromancer
entries: {@i Command the Powers of Death and Undeath}

You explore the forces of life, death, and undeath. As a necromancer, you learn to manipulate the energy that animates all creatures, and you draw increasing power from the forbidden secrets in your spellbook. Though many see Necromancers as menacing or villainous, not all Necromancers are evil.

subclassFeatures.name: Necromancy Savant
entries: Choose two {@filter Magicien spells from the Necromancy school|spells|level=0;1;2|class=Magicien|school=N}, each of which must be no higher than level 2, and add them to your spellbook for free.

In addition, whenever you gain access to a new level of spell slots in this class, you can add one {@filter Magicien spell from the Necromancy school|spells|class=Magicien|school=N} to your spellbook for free. The chosen spell must be of a level for which you have spell slots.

subclassFeatures.name: Necromancy Spellbook
entries: Your spellbook's necromantic secrets grant you additional powers. You gain the following benefits.

entries.name: Necrotic Resistance
entries: You have {@variantrule Résistance|PHB24} to Necrotic damage.

entries.name: Undead Familiar
entries: The {@spell Find Familiar|PHB24} spell appears in your spellbook. When you cast the spell, you choose one of the normal forms for your familiar or one of the following special forms: {@creature Skeleton|XMM} ou {@creature Zombie|XMM} (see appendix B of the {@book Player's Handbook|PHB24|11} for the familiar's stat block). When you choose one of the normal forms, you can choose Undead as its creature type.
Additionally, when you take the {@action Attaque|PHB24} action, you can forgo one of your own attacks to allow your familiar to make one attack of its own with its {@variantrule Réaction|PHB24}.

entries.name: Undead Vitality
entries: When you cast a {@filter Necromancy spell|spells|school=N} using a spell slot, you can choose an Undead creature you can see within 60 feet of yourself to regain a number of {@variantrule Points de Vie|PHB24} equal to the level of the spell slot expended plus your Magicien level.

subclassFeatures.name: Grave Power
entries: You have discovered more necromantic insights and inscribed them in your spellbook. While holding your spellbook, you gain the following benefits.

entries.name: Grave Resilience
entries: When you use Arcane Recovery, your {@condition Exhaustion|PHB24} level, if any, decreases by 1.

entries.name: Overwhelming Necrosis
entries: Damage from your Magicien spells and Magicien features ignores {@variantrule Résistance|PHB24} to Necrotic damage.

subclassFeatures.name: Undead Thralls
entries: You always have {@spell Animate Dead|PHB24} prepared and can cast it sans dépenser d'emplacement de sort, but you must finish a {@variantrule Repos long|PHB24} before you can cast it in this way again. Whenever you start casting the spell, you can increase the spell's effective level by 1.
In addition, while holding your spellbook, you gain the following benefits.

entries.name: Undead Fortitude
entries: Whenever you cast a {@filter Necromancy spell|spells|school=N} that creates or summons an Undead, the Undead's {@variantrule Hit Points|PHB24|Hit Point} maximum and current {@variantrule Points de Vie|PHB24} increase by a number égale à votre Intelligence modifier plus half your Magicien level (round down).

entries.name: Withering Strike
entries: Whenever an Undead you control within 60 feet of you hits a creature with an attack roll, the Undead deals extra Necrotic damage égale à votre Intelligence modifier (minimum of 1 Necrotic damage).

subclassFeatures.name: Harvest Undead
entries: You have learned more secrets about the nuances of life and death. Immediately after you become {@status En péril|PHB24} but aren't reduced to 0 {@variantrule Points de Vie|PHB24} from taking damage, you can take a {@variantrule Réaction|PHB24} to reduce an Undead creature under your control that you can see to 0 {@variantrule Points de Vie|PHB24}. You then immediately regain a number of {@variantrule Points de Vie|PHB24} égale à votre Magicien level.

subclassFeatures.name: Death's Master
entries: Abstruse rituals within your spellbook allow you mastery over undeath. While holding your spellbook, you gain the following benefits.

entries.name: Bolster Undead
entries: Par une {@variantrule Action Bonus|PHB24}, choose any number of Undead you have created or summoned with a {@filter Necromancy spell|spells|school=N} that are within 60 feet of you. Those Undead each gain {@variantrule Points de Vie Temporaires|PHB24} égale à votre Magicien level. Once you use this {@variantrule Action Bonus|PHB24}, you can't do so again until you finish a {@variantrule Repos long|PHB24}.

entries.name: Extinguish Undead
entries: When an Undead creature you can see is reduced to 0 {@variantrule Points de Vie|PHB24}, you can cause it to explode with necrotic energy. Roll a number of d6s equal to half the creature's unexpended {@variantrule Hit Point Dice|PHB24|Hit Dice} (round up, minimum of {@dice 1d6}), and add them together. Each creature in a 10-foot {@variantrule Émanation [Area of Effect]|PHB24|Émanation} originating from the Undead makes a Dexterity saving throw. On a failed save, a target takes Necrotic damage equal to the number rolled and can't take {@variantrule Reaction|PHB24|Reactions} until the start of its next turn. On a successful save, a target takes half as much damage only. When you use this feature to explode an Undead creature you don't control, you must take a {@variantrule Réaction|PHB24} and expend a level 5+ spell slot to do so.

subclassFeatures.name: Transmuter
entries: {@i Transform Energy and Matter}
You study spells that modify energy and matter—to you, the world is eminently mutable. Using your magic, you become a smith at reality's forge.
Some Transmuters are tinkerers and pranksters. Others seek the power to make and destroy worlds.

subclassFeatures.name: Transmutation Savant
entries: Choose two {@filter Magicien spells from the Transmutation school|spells|level=0;1;2|class=Magicien|school=T}, each of which must be no higher than level 2, and add them to your spellbook for free.

In addition, whenever you gain access to a new level of spell slots in this class, you can add one {@filter Magicien spell from the Transmutation school|spells|class=Magicien|school=T} to your spellbook for free. The chosen spell must be of a level for which you have spell slots.

subclassFeatures.name: Transmuter's Stone
entries: When you finish a {@variantrule Repos long|PHB24}, you can create a magic stone that lasts until you use this feature again. The stone is a Tiny object, and you can use it as a {@variantrule Focaliseur d'incantation|PHB24} for your Magicien spells. A creature with the stone in its possession gains proficiency in Constitution saving throws and one of the following benefits, which you choose when you create the stone. You can change the stone's benefit when you cast a {@filter Transmutation spell|spells|school=T} using a spell slot.

entries.name: Vision dans le noir
entries: The bearer gains {@sense Vision dans le noir|PHB24} with a range of 60 feet or increases the range of its {@sense Vision dans le noir|PHB24} by 60 feet.

entries.name: Resistance
entries: The bearer gains {@variantrule Résistance|PHB24} to Acid, Cold, Fire, Lightning, Poison, or Thunder damage (your choice each time you choose this benefit).

entries.name: Speed
entries: The bearer's {@variantrule Vitesse|PHB24} increases by 10 feet.

subclassFeatures.name: Wondrous Alteration
entries: You always have the {@spell Alter Self|PHB24} spell prepared and can cast it once sans dépenser d'emplacement de sort. You regain the ability to cast it in this way when you finish a {@variantrule Repos long|PHB24}.
While under the effects of {@spell Alter Self|PHB24}, you gain an additional benefit for each of its options.

entries.name: Aquatic Adaptation
entries: While underwater, you can take the {@action Pointe|PHB24} action as a {@variantrule Action Bonus|PHB24}.

entries.name: Change Appearance
entries: You have {@variantrule Avantage|PHB24} on Charisma ({@skill Tromperie|PHB24}) checks.

entries.name: Natural Weapons
entries: The damage of your new growth increases to {@dice 2d6} damage of the type associated with the growth. You also have {@variantrule Avantage|PHB24} on Constitution saving throws to maintain {@status Concentration|PHB24}.

subclassFeatures.name: Empowered Transmutation
entries: When you use a spell slot to cast a {@filter Transmutation spell|spells|school=T} that doesn't make an attack roll or force a saving throw, such as {@spell vol|PHB24} ou {@spell arme magique|PHB24}, you can increase the spell's effective level by 1.
You can use this feature a number of times égale à votre Intelligence modifier (minimum of once), and you regain all expended uses when you finish a {@variantrule Repos long|PHB24}.

subclassFeatures.name: Potent Stone
entries: Your Transmuter's Stone is more versatile. When you create your Transmuter's Stone, you can choose up to two benefits. You can choose each option other than {@b Resistance} only once. If you choose {@b Resistance} twice, you must choose different damage types. You can change either or both benefits when you cast a {@filter Transmutation spell|spells|school=T} using a spell slot.
In addition, the following are now among your benefit options for Transmuter's Stone.

entries.name: Mighty Build
entries: The bearer has {@variantrule Avantage|PHB24} on Strength saving throws. The bearer also counts as one size larger when determining its carrying capacity.

entries.name: Tremorsense
entries: The bearer gains {@sense Tremorsense|PHB24} with a range of 30 feet.

subclassFeatures.name: Shape-Shifter
entries: You always have the {@spell métamorphose|PHB24} spell prepared and can cast it once sans dépenser d'emplacement de sort. You regain the ability to cast it in this way when you finish a {@variantrule Repos long|PHB24}.

In addition, when you target yourself with the spell, you can modify the spell to gain the benefits below. Once you modify the spell using this feature, you can't do so again until you finish a {@variantrule Repos long|PHB24}.

entries.name: Game Statistics
entries: In addition to retaining the features specified in the spell, you retain your memories and ability to communicate. You also retain your Intelligence, Wisdom, and Charisma scores; proficiencies; class features; and feats.

entries.name: Transmute Spells
entries: While shape-shifted, you can cast spells, but only {@filter Transmutation spells|spells|school=T} that don't have a Material component that has a specified cost or that is consumed by the spell.

subclassFeatures.name: Master Transmuter
entries: While you carry your Transmuter's Stone, you can take a {@action Magique|PHB24} action to consume the reserve of transmutation magic stored inside and choose one of the following benefits. After you use the stone in this way, it crumbles to dust. You can prevent the stone from crumbling by expending a level 7+ spell slot as part of the {@action Magique|PHB24} action you take using this feature.

entries.name: Major Transformation
entries: You can transmute one nonmagical object—no larger than a 10-foot {@variantrule Cube [Area of Effect]|PHB24|Cube} or eight connected 5-foot Cubes—into another nonmagical object of similar size and mass and of equal or lesser value. You must spend 10 minutes handling the object to transform it.

entries.name: Panacea
entries: You touch a creature as part of this {@action Magique|PHB24} action, and the target regains a number of {@variantrule Points de Vie|PHB24} equal to half its {@variantrule Hit Points|PHB24|Hit Point} maximum (round down). The target is cured of all magical contagions, and any curses affecting the target are lifted, including the target's {@variantrule Harmonisation|PHB24} to a cursed item. If the target has the {@condition Empoisonné|PHB24} ou {@condition Petrified|PHB24} condition, those conditions end.

entries.name: Restore Vie
entries: You cast the {@spell Raise Dead|PHB24} spell sans dépenser d'emplacement de sort, using the stone in place of the required Material components.

entries.name: Restore Youth
entries: You touch one willing creature as part of this {@action Magique|PHB24} action, and the target's {@condition Exhaustion|PHB24} level, if any, decreases to 0, and it permanently appears {@dice 3d10} years younger, to a minimum of young adulthood.

classFeatures.name: Style de combat
entries: Vous avez perfectionné vos compétences martiales et obtenez un don de {@filter style de combat feat|feats|category=FS} de votre choix. La {@feat Défense|PHB24} est recommandée.
Chaque fois que vous gagnez un niveau de Guerrier, vous pouvez remplacer le don que vous avez choisi par un don de {@filter style de combat feat|feats|category=FS} différent.

classFeatures.name: Second souffle
entries: Vous disposez d'une réserve limitée d'endurance physique et mentale sur laquelle vous pouvez puiser. Par une action bonus, vous pouvez récupérer un nombre de points de vie égal à 1d10 plus votre niveau de guerrier.

Vous pouvez utiliser cette capacité deux fois. Vous récupérez une utilisation dépensée lorsque vous terminez un repos court, et vous récupérez toutes vos utilisations dépensées lorsque vous terminez un repos long.

Lorsque vous atteignez certains niveaux de Combattant, vous obtenez davantage d'utilisations de cette fonctionnalité, comme indiqué dans la colonne Second Souffle du tableau des Fonctionnalités du Combattant.

classFeatures.name: Maîtrise des armes
entries: Votre entraînement aux armes vous permet d'utiliser les propriétés de maîtrise de trois types d' armes simples ou martiales de votre choix. Après chaque repos long, vous pouvez vous entraîner aux techniques d'armes et changer l'une de ces armes.

Lorsque vous atteignez certains niveaux de Combattant, vous obtenez la capacité d'utiliser les propriétés de maîtrise de davantage de types d'armes, comme indiqué dans la colonne Maîtrise des armes du tableau des Caractéristiques du Combattant.

classFeatures.name: Surcharge d'action
entries: Vous pouvez vous surpasser momentanément. À votre tour, vous pouvez effectuer une action supplémentaire, à l'exception de l' action magique.

Une fois cette capacité utilisée, vous ne pourrez plus l'utiliser avant d'avoir terminé un repos court ou long. À partir du niveau 17, vous pourrez l'utiliser deux fois avant un repos, mais une seule fois par tour.

classFeatures.name: Esprit tactique
entries: Vous avez le sens tactique, sur le champ de bataille comme en dehors. En cas d'échec à un test de caractéristique, vous pouvez utiliser une charge de votre Second Souffle pour tenter de réussir. Au lieu de récupérer des points de vie, vous lancez 1d10 et ajoutez le résultat au test, ce qui peut potentiellement le transformer en réussite. Si le test échoue malgré tout, cette charge de Second Souffle n'est pas consommée.

classFeatures.name: Sous-Classe Guerrier
entries: Vous obtenez une sous-classe de Guerrier de votre choix. Une sous-classe est une spécialisation qui vous octroie des capacités à certains niveaux de Guerrier. Pour le reste de votre carrière, vous bénéficiez de toutes les capacités de votre sous-classe correspondant à votre niveau de Guerrier ou à un niveau inférieur.

classFeatures.name: Amélioration de caractéristique
entries: Vous recevez le don {@feat Amélioration de caractéristique|PHB24} ou un autre {@5etools don|feats.html} de votre choix pour lequel vous remplissez les condition. Vous recevez de nouveau cette aptitude aux niveau de Fighter 6, 8, 12, 14, et 16.

classFeatures.name: Attaque supplémentaire
entries: Vous pouvez attaquer deux fois au lieu d'une seule fois chaque fois que vous effectuez l' action Attaquer pendant votre tour.

classFeatures.name: Changement tactique
entries: Chaque fois que vous activez votre Second Souffle avec une Action Bonus, vous pouvez vous déplacer jusqu'à la moitié de votre Vitesse sans provoquer d'Attaques d'Opportunité.

classFeatures.name: Amélioration de caractéristique
entries: Vous recevez le don {@feat Amélioration de caractéristique|PHB24} ou un autre {@5etools don|feats.html} de votre choix pour lequel vous remplissez les condition.

classFeatures.name: Capacité de sous-classe
entries: Vous gagnez une aptitude de votre sous-classe de Fighter.

classFeatures.name: Amélioration de caractéristique
entries: Vous recevez le don {@feat Amélioration de caractéristique|PHB24} ou un autre {@5etools don|feats.html} de votre choix pour lequel vous remplissez les condition.

classFeatures.name: Indomptable
entries: En cas d'échec à un jet de sauvegarde, vous pouvez le relancer avec un bonus égal à votre niveau de Guerrier. Vous devez utiliser le nouveau résultat, et vous ne pouvez plus utiliser cette capacité avant d'avoir terminé un repos long.
Vous pouvez utiliser cette fonctionnalité deux fois avant un repos long à partir du niveau 13 et trois fois avant un repos long à partir du niveau 17.

classFeatures.name: Maître tactique
entries: Lorsque vous attaquez avec une arme dont vous pouvez utiliser la propriété de maîtrise, vous pouvez remplacer cette propriété par la propriété Poussée, Affaiblissement ou Ralentissement pour cette attaque.

classFeatures.name: Capacité de sous-classe
entries: Vous gagnez une aptitude de votre sous-classe de Fighter.

classFeatures.name: Deux attaques supplémentaires
entries: Vous pouvez attaquer trois fois au lieu d'une seule fois lorsque vous effectuez l' action Attaquer pendant votre tour.

classFeatures.name: Amélioration de caractéristique
entries: Vous recevez le don {@feat Amélioration de caractéristique|PHB24} ou un autre {@5etools don|feats.html} de votre choix pour lequel vous remplissez les condition.

classFeatures.name: Indomptable
entries: En cas d'échec à un jet de sauvegarde, vous pouvez le relancer avec un bonus égal à votre niveau de Guerrier. Vous devez utiliser le nouveau résultat, et vous ne pouvez plus utiliser cette capacité avant d'avoir terminé un repos long.
Vous pouvez utiliser cette fonctionnalité deux fois avant un repos long à partir du niveau 13 et trois fois avant un repos long à partir du niveau 17.

classFeatures.name: Attaques étudiées
entries: Vous étudiez vos adversaires et tirez des leçons de chaque attaque. Si vous ratez votre jet d'attaque contre une créature, vous bénéficiez d' un avantage à votre prochain jet d'attaque contre cette créature avant la fin de votre prochain tour.

classFeatures.name: Amélioration de caractéristique
entries: Vous recevez le don {@feat Amélioration de caractéristique|PHB24} ou un autre {@5etools don|feats.html} de votre choix pour lequel vous remplissez les condition.

classFeatures.name: Capacité de sous-classe
entries: Vous gagnez une aptitude de votre sous-classe de Fighter.

classFeatures.name: Amélioration de caractéristique
entries: Vous recevez le don {@feat Amélioration de caractéristique|PHB24} ou un autre {@5etools don|feats.html} de votre choix pour lequel vous remplissez les condition.

classFeatures.name: Surcharge d'action
entries: Vous pouvez vous surpasser momentanément. À votre tour, vous pouvez effectuer une action supplémentaire, à l'exception de l' action magique.

Une fois cette capacité utilisée, vous ne pourrez plus l'utiliser avant d'avoir terminé un repos court ou long. À partir du niveau 17, vous pourrez l'utiliser deux fois avant un repos, mais une seule fois par tour.

classFeatures.name: Indomptable
entries: En cas d'échec à un jet de sauvegarde, vous pouvez le relancer avec un bonus égal à votre niveau de Guerrier. Vous devez utiliser le nouveau résultat, et vous ne pouvez plus utiliser cette capacité avant d'avoir terminé un repos long.
Vous pouvez utiliser cette fonctionnalité deux fois avant un repos long à partir du niveau 13 et trois fois avant un repos long à partir du niveau 17.

classFeatures.name: Capacité de sous-classe
entries: Vous gagnez une aptitude de votre sous-classe de Fighter.

classFeatures.name: Bénédiction épique
entries: Vous obtenez un don de  {@filter Don épique feat|feats|category=EB} ou un autre {@5etools don|feats.html}de votre choix pour lequel vous remplissez les conditions requises. Le {@feat don de Prouesse au combat|PHB24} de sorts est recommandé.

classFeatures.name: Trois attaques supplémentaires
entries: Vous pouvez attaquer quatre fois au lieu d'une seule fois lorsque vous effectuez l' action Attaquer pendant votre tour.

subclassFeatures.name: Purple Dragon Knight (Banneret)
entries: Purple Dragon Knights are warriors who hail from the kingdom of Cormyr. Pledged to protect the crown, they take the fight against evil beyond the kingdom's borders. They are tasked with wetering the let as knights errant, relying on their judgment, bravery, et fidelity to guide them in defeating evildoers.

A Purple Dragon Knight inspires greatness in others by committing brave deeds in battle. The mere presence of a knight in a hamlet is enough to cause some orcs et betits to seek easier prey. A lone knight is a skilled warrior, but a knight leading a bet of allies can transform even the most poorly equipped militia into a ferocious war bet.
A knight prefers to lead through deeds, not words. As a knight spearheads an attack, the knight's actions can awaken reserves of courage et conviction in allies that they never suspected they had.

subclassFeatures.name: Rallying Cry
entries: When you choose this archetype at 3e level, you learn how to inspire your allies to fight on past their injuries.

When you use your Second Wind feature, you can choose up to three creatures within 60 feet of you that are allied with you. Each one regains hit points égale à votre fighter level, provided that the creature can see or hear you.

subclassFeatures.name: Restriction: Knighthood
entries: Purple Dragon Knights are tied to a specific order of Cormyrean knighthood.
Banneret serves as the generic name for this archetype if you use it in other campaign settings or to model warlords other than the Purple Dragon Knights.

subclassFeatures.name: Royal Envoy
entries: A Purple Dragon Knight serves as an envoy of the Cormyrean crown. Knights of high steting are expected to conduct themselves with grace.

At 7e level, you gain proficiency in the {@skill Persuasion} skill. If you are already proficient in it, you gain proficiency in one of the following skills of your choice: {@skill Animal Hetling}, {@skill Insight}, {@skill Intimidation}, or {@skill Performance}.
Your proficiency bonus is doubled for any ability check you make that uses {@skill Persuasion}. You receive this benefit regardless of the skill proficiency you gain from this feature.

subclassFeatures.name: Inspiring Surge
entries: Starting at 10e level, when you use your Action Surge feature, you can choose one creature within 60 feet of you that is allied with you. That creature can make one melee or ranged weapon attack with its reaction, provided that it can see or hear you.
Starting at 18e level, you can choose two allies within 60 feet of you, rather than one.

subclassFeatures.name: Bulwark
entries: Beginning at 15e level, you can extend the benefit of your Indomitable feature to an ally. When you decide to use Indomitable to reroll an Intelligence, a Wisdom, or a Charisma saving throw et you aren't {@condition incapacitated}, you can choose one ally within 60 feet of you that also failed its saving throw against the same effect. If that creature can see or hear you, it can reroll its saving throw et must use the new roll.

subclassFeatures.name: Inspiring Surge
entries: Starting at 18e level, you can choose two allies within 60 feet of you, rather than one.

subclassFeatures.name: Arcane Archer
entries: An Arcane Archer studies a unique elven method of archery that weaves magic into attacks to produce supernatural effects. Arcane Archers are some of the most elite warriors among the elves. They stet watch over the fringes of elven domains, keeping a keen eye out for trespassers et using magic-infused arrows to defeat monsters et invaders before they can reach elven settlements. Over the centuries, the methods of these elf archers have been learned by members of other races who can also balance arcane aptitude with archery.

subclassFeatures.name: Arcane Archer Savoir
entries: At 3e level, you learn magical theory or some of the secrets of nature—typical for practitioners of this elven martial tradition. You choose to gain proficiency in either the {@skill Arcana} or the {@skill Nature} skill, et you choose to learn either the {@spell prestidigitation} or the {@spell druidcraft} cantrip.

subclassFeatures.name: Arcane Shot
entries: At 3e level, you learn to unleash special magical effects with some of your shots. When you gain this feature, you learn two Arcane Shot options of your choice (see "Arcane Shot Options"below).

Once per turn when you fire an arrow from a shortbow or longbow as part of the {@action Attack} action, you can apply one of your Arcane Shot options to that arrow. You decide to use the option when the arrow hits a creature, unless the option doesn't involve an attack roll. You have two uses of this ability, et you regain all expended uses of it when you finish a short or long rest.
You gain an additional Arcane Shot option of your choice when you reach certain levels in this class: 7e, 10e, 15e, et 18e level. Each option also improves when you become an 18e-level fighter.

subclassFeatures.name: Arcane Shot Options
entries: The Arcane Shot feature lets you choose options for it at certain levels. The options are presented here in alphabetical order. They are all magical effects, et each one is associated with one of the schools of magic.
If an option requires a saving throw, your Arcane Shot save DC is calculated as follows:

subclassFeatures.name: Additional Arcane Shot Option
entries: You gain an additional Arcane Shot option of your choice when you reach 7e level.

subclassFeatures.name: Curving Shot
entries: At 7e level, you learn how to direct an errant arrow toward a new target. When you make an attack roll with a magic arrow et miss, you can use a bonus action to reroll the attack roll against a different target within 60 feet of the original target.

subclassFeatures.name: Magic Arrow
entries: At 7e level, you gain the ability to infuse arrows with magic. Whenever you fire a nonmagical arrow from a shortbow or longbow, you can make it magical for the purpose of overcoming resistance et immunity to nonmagical attacks et damage. The magic fades from the arrow immediately after it hits or misses its target.

subclassFeatures.name: Additional Arcane Shot Option
entries: You gain an additional Arcane Shot option of your choice when you reach 10e level.

subclassFeatures.name: Additional Arcane Shot Option
entries: You gain an additional Arcane Shot option of your choice when you reach 15e level.

subclassFeatures.name: Ever-Ready Shot
entries: Starting at 15e level, your magical archery is available whenever battle starts. If you roll initiative et have no uses of Arcane Shot remaining, you regain one use of it.

subclassFeatures.name: Additional Arcane Shot Option
entries: You gain an additional Arcane Shot option of your choice when you reach 18e level. Each option also improves when you become an 18e-level fighter.

subclassFeatures.name: Cavalier
entries: The archetypal Cavalier excels at mounted combat. Usually born among the nobility et raised at court, a Cavalier is equally at home leading a cavalry charge or exchanging repartee at a state dinner. Cavaliers also learn how to guard those in their charge from harm, often serving as the protectors of their superiors et of the weak. Compelled to right wrongs or earn prestige, many of these fighters leave their lives of comfort to embark on glorious adventure.

subclassFeatures.name: Bonus Proficiency
entries: When you choose this archetype at 3e level, you gain proficiency in one of the following skills of your choice: {@skill Animal Hetling}, {@skill History}, {@skill Insight}, {@skill Performance}, or {@skill Persuasion}. Alternatively, you learn one language of your choice.

subclassFeatures.name: Born to the Saddle
entries: Starting at 3e level, your mastery as a rider becomes apparent. Vous disposez d'unedvantage on saving throws made to avoid falling off your mount. If you fall off your mount et descend no more than 10 feet, you can let on your feet if you're not {@condition incapacitated}.
Finally, mounting or dismounting a creature costs you only 5 feet of movement, rather than half your speed.

subclassFeatures.name: Unwavering Mark
